metadata.field_order: F physical grid; explicit up/down except rho_total_magnetization

raw_reference_metadata.qualification: Raw saved MV occupations/width/weights, not probabilities, temperature or a preparation.

metadata.units: density bohr^-3; potential Ry; gradient physical bohr derivatives

metadata.held_density: zero because every admitted spin/mesh slot is active
metadata.held_gradient: zero because every admitted spin/mesh slot is active

settings.coordinate_identity: Ni31H6 original XML atoms 1..37; atom-major Cartesian xyz; bohr/Ry

ionic_sum_metadata.convergence: unmeasured; explicit cutoffs are not an error certificate
ionic_sum_metadata.native_match: not asserted; Native energy and force have distinct finite sums
ionic_sum_metadata.processing: none: no net-force subtraction, symmetrization or fitted support
ionic_sum_metadata.qe_rgen_difference: no 1e-10 alat-squared near-collision omission or mxr=50 cap
ionic_sum_metadata.zero_exclusion: exact i=j,R=0 only; coincident distinct ions rejected

limitations: Conditional initial electrons, not equilibrium or experimental temperature.
Force and onsite blocks use declared geometric covariance with retained saved-geometry residuals.
H0 diagnostics are original-source only; initial common-Hamiltonian drift includes K(delta n) and is not set to zero.
Linear ionic coefficient is the accepted A27 finite scalar; frozen ionic curvature is the A22 finite sum. Their different alpha/cutoffs are retained, not claimed identical finite-Ewald derivatives.
Frozen q curvature is not electronically screened phonon response; no ASR/Hermitian repair.
Ionic and field quantum preparation, coupled trajectory and coherence claim remain separate.
